description: This script performs performance benchmarking by comparing actual and expected CSV data for different test cases, identifying regressions or improvements in execution time.

methods.name: get_field
methods.description: Retrieves a specific field value for a given case from a CSV DataFrame, returns None if not found or error occurs.

methods.name: check_perf
methods.description: Compares actual and expected performance data, categorizes cases as pass, improved, failed, or baseline not found, and generates a report message.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, loads CSV files, performs performance checks, and exits with status code 1 if failures are detected.
